title: Right to a fair trial: ECHR Article 6 and EU Charter Article 47
instrument: European Convention on Human Rights, Art. 6(1); Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union, Art. 47
description: A fair hearing before an independent and impartial tribunal, with equality of arms and the right to be heard on everything the decision rests on.

requirements.title: Adversarial proceedings
requirements.text: Every authority the system found that no party cited is marked in the report.

requirements.title: Being heard on what the decision rests on
requirements.text: The parties are heard on every point and authority the decision relies on.
requirements.statement: Any authority or point not raised by the parties that I rely on will first be put to the parties.

requirements.title: Equality of arms
requirements.text: Each party's material is presented with equal care.
requirements.instruction: Present each party's material and arguments with equal care and in comparable terms; do not favour the party whose papers are longer or better organised.

requirements.title: An independent and impartial tribunal
requirements.text: The system gives a decision-maker or neutral no view on who should succeed.

requirements.title: A reasoned decision
requirements.text: The decision and its reasons are the decision-maker's own; nothing in the report is a reason for decision.
